review.why: Tailors one resume to one posting with a requirement-to-evidence table, gap questions instead of invention and honest ATS advice.
review.summary: Tailors a resume to a job description: weighted requirement table, evidence map, gap questions, rewrite on a copy (headline, summary, bullet order, skills), parse and defensibility checks, optional cover letter. Three depth tiers, six reference files, and an optional Reactive Resume tool path with review gates.
strengths: Facts are locked: a gap becomes a question, never a fill-in
Weighted coverage table with honest labels, not a match score to chase
Checks knockout questions first and corrects ATS myths
cautions: Long skill (34,000 characters) that loads six reference files as needed
The tool section only helps when Reactive Resume is connected
Optional AI tools send the full resume and posting to a provider; it says to ask first
